CHARTER for Arc 69 (the team coordination home). SCOPE: a batched substrate-hygiene BUG-SWEEP -- ~13 small, independent substrate-tool/canon bugs that each need the gauntlet (not a direct edit, per the substrate-tooling-needs-an-arc rule), batched into one cleanup arc. Standard POLYBIUS+PLINY team (a bug-sweep, NOT custom-agent/workflow design -> NO CHIRON/HAMILTON).

THE BUG CLUSTER (organized; each ticket carries its own file:line repro -- read the ticket):

CLUSTER A -- author-gate (LOAD-BEARING; this gate runs on EVERY commit, extra care):
- stoa--a2x: authorship PreToolUse gate FALSE-POSITIVES on security/design prose discussing ownership.
- stoa--y12: author-gate cfg extractor requires a :/= separator -> a standard "Copyright (c) <year> <name>" LICENSE line is NOT matched (true-positive MISS).
- stoa--ez9: author-field gate hard-blocks legit source-citation + audit-prose fields (no reviewed-allow path).
- stoa--iyl: install.sh seeds the author-audit allow-list with the git identity only, not the artifact-author name -> false-blocks the PRINCIPAL own commits.

CLUSTER B -- save-verdict module:
- stoa--qsf: save-verdict --threat-coverage-probe-ids regex requires lowercase p but designs label probes P1..P11 (uppercase).
- stoa--luo: save-verdict attach_status is a prose-contract, not mechanized rc-capture in the byte-aligned block.

CLUSTER C -- install.sh / check robustness:
- stoa--3nh: FAIL-LOUD on an empty MAJOR_*/CAPTAIN_* glob in check-substrate-updates + the install.sh manifest writer (silent-zero hazard).
- stoa--kr7: sweep residual POLYBIUS/PLINY-only MAJOR references off install.sh non-enumeration paths (deploy-summary echo + fresh-DEPLOY block) for glob-derive consistency.
- stoa--p41.3: check-bw-release/check.sh curl lacks --max-time.

CLUSTER D -- tooling / doc:
- stoa--p41.4: MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md "base-team sync skill" loose-historical framing for retired check tools.
- stoa--waa: launch-team.ps1 panes/tabs append multi-word activation prompts UNQUOTED (CONFIRM liveness post-Arc-68 -- Arc 68 added single-quote wrapping for the chain preamble at L321; the general multi-word-prompt case may remain).
- stoa--vr1: validate-spec residue refinement (10 categories from Arc 43 A22).
- stoa--tg7: substrate-tool commits (apply.sh/install.sh/revert.sh) omit the op-disc 28.9 seat-identity trailer.

KEY CONSTRAINT (DC0): DAEDALUS GROUNDS each ticket FIRST -- confirm it is still LIVE (not already fixed by Arcs 66-68) and a SMALL independent fix. Any that turns out bigger-than-a-cleanup (needs real design/architecture, not a one-spot fix) -> SURFACE for re-scope; ticket-and-skip it, do NOT force it into the sweep. Cluster A is LOAD-BEARING -- its fixes must ADD the missed/allow cases WITHOUT regressing the 16/16 author-gate tests or re-opening false-blocks; ez9 reviewed-allow-path is the one genuine DESIGN question.

GAUNTLET: full DAEDALUS -> ARGUS -> ADA -> VERA -> CATO -> NOMOS; substrate tooling/canon, so CATO/NOMOS carry weight (esp. Cluster A author-gate). DOGFOOD: sign every comm [from: <NAME> | sid <session-id>].

Directive (detailed spec + DC items): substrate/arcs/arc-69-build-directive.md. Owner: Polybius_the_Stoa (user-tier, sid 990b0750-5572-4836-b9c7-18d626a12e96). Builds on main 8e4b20c. Report-up anchor: this charter (no separate user-tier ticket -- this is a the-stoa internal cleanup).

DIVERGENCE -- type: ticket-state | classification: WRONG-SPEC (for the qsf cluster-B framing; directive DC0 already routes such cases to RE-SCOPE).
detail: Directive line 34 frames stoa--qsf as a Cluster-B 'save-verdict module' FIX (probe-id regex lowercase-p vs uppercase P1..P11) to fix in substrate/modules/save-verdict.md. Ground truth: that canonical is ALREADY FIXED -- save-verdict.md:66 and :128 use ^[pP] (case-insensitive); :128 states the j2i bug 'is retired by this module'. Per qsf's own bw comments (floor-manager + PLINY, 2026-06-18, both ACK'd), the live symptom is a the-stoa DEPLOY-DRIFT (.claude/skills/save-verdict/_save_verdict.py:105 pre-Arc-64 lowercase regex) folded into stoa--ruu; qsf was DEFERRED to user-tier POLYBIUS for re-scope-or-supersede, NOT a clean save-verdict-source FIX. The directive's Cluster-B fix-path for qsf cannot pass as posed.
evidence: bw show stoa--qsf (2 comments establishing canonical-already-fixed + deferred-to-rescope); grep save-verdict.md -> L66/L128 ^[pP] intentional, j2i retired.

NOTE (NOT divergences -- ground-truth corroboration): qsf is still OPEN (correct -- deferred, not closed); so it is NOT a 'closed ticket in the FIX target'. The other 12 tickets all EXIST and are OPEN. The directive's DC0 ('GROUND each ticket FIRST; ALREADY-FIXED -> close with ref; RE-SCOPE -> ticket-and-skip') is the orchestrator's own designed catch for exactly this -- so the unit is recoverable in-flight, not impossible. NOMOS flags it because the directive's CLUSTER-B narrative presents qsf as a live save-verdict-module FIX when bw says otherwise.

CONFORMANT on: Probe 1 (4 clusters / DC0 / standard-POLYBIUS+PLINY no-CHIRON/HAMILTON all match charter); Probe 2 (13 tickets all exist + OPEN; y12/p41.3/tg7/qsf bodies carry real file:line repros); Probe 3 (all 9 named surfaces exist); Probe 4 (arc-69 no collision; builds-on 8e4b20c == HEAD; author line = Polybius_the_Stoa on behalf of PRINCIPAL Denson Smith, no foreign field; DC1 '16/16 author-gate tests' == actual suite: 16 passed/0 failed; DC3 byte-aligned region present in ARGUS/VERA/CATO).
Returning.
